    crv_obj.name = name

    crv.dimensions = '3D'

    p1 = crv.splines[0].bezier_points[1]

    p1.co = Vector(end)

    p0.handle_right = Vector(start) + Vector(mid_offset)
    p1.handle_left = Vector(end) - Vector(mid_offset)

    # Material
